title: Single extracted bitmap entry
description: Contract for one extracted bitmap: source tag provenance, family, format, dimensions, and output digests.

source.description: Registry path of the source SWF file.

tag.description: SWF tag code of the bitmap definition.

character_id.description: Bitmap character ID within its file.

family.description: Bitmap family: jpeg, jpeg3, or lossless.

format.description: Native bitmap format code (lossless 3/5; JPEG families record 0).

width.description: Bitmap width in pixels (from tag fields or JPEG SOF).

height.description: Bitmap height in pixels (from tag fields or JPEG SOF).

outputs.description: Output files with digests, in write order.
